The structure of Sm₂Ga₄Rh₄ (Sm(GaRh)₂) is tetragonal with space group I-4m2 (No. 119) and a unit cell containing 10 atoms across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ga and Rh each have 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Sm has 16 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Ga- and Rh-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, corner- and face-sharing between Ga-centered polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Rh-centered polyhedra.
